env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified elan launcher

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean replay subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary directory writable. The checker performs no dependency update, build, clone, or fetch.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 summary bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.expected_output_policy: Six exact summary lines report provisional narrow kernel, trust, and provenance passes plus fail-closed structured-authority, hermetic, and independent gates.
recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero replay of the exact statement and the partial Euler-product proof, plus a same-worker no-Proof reconstruction and selected direct source/olean provenance. This does not prove the Hardy-Ramanujan root, reconcile the frozen graph, establish accepted foundation/TCB closure, perform a cold release rebuild, or provide distinct-runner independence.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation receipt. It cannot accept the proof dependency, validate the stale M0-L terminal-transport claim, close the root, or establish M0/E0/E1, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
